articles.image_title: Brandanschlag auf Stromnetz in Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 5: In an aerial view, the Mexikoplatz S-Bahn train station stands in the dark in the Zehlendorf district while a generator operates a street light during a power outage, following an arson attack on power cables on January 5, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack occurred at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal and caused a blackout affecting about 45,000 residents, as well as local businesses, hospitals, and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. Stromnetz Berlin, the local utility company, has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents, but others may face a longer wait for reconnection. Police said the perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning. The incident is similar to an attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025. Local news outlets reported that an extreme left-wing group, Vulkangruppe (Volcano Group), claimed responsibility for the arson. (Footage by Christian Ender/Getty Images)
